title: WTShiftBench: a problem-solving benchmark protocol for endpoint-aligned auditing of transcriptomic perturbation model outputs
description: WTShiftBench v1.2.1 provides a sampling-aware endpoint definition, scoring code for matrices with explicit target and gene axes, five-seed CellOT evaluation, and reported training- and feature-seed checks. The code snapshot is not the complete data archive. See the current reproducibility guide for assets and the scope of actual verification.
